lines.en: I drag my shell along.
I go slowly. The shell is heavy.

lines.zh: 河里水浅，我一步一步蹚。
lines.en: The river's shallow. I wade step by step.
Swamp mud pulls at my feet.

lines.zh: 我沿着海滩走，壳上沾沙。
lines.en: I walk the beach and sand clings to my shell.

lines.zh: 我从林子的湿气里穿过。
lines.en: I pass through the damp of the woods.

lines.zh: 我的身体软，走起来一晃一晃。
lines.en: My body's soft, so I wobble as I go.
I step into the water without a care.

lines.zh: 我扭头看看壳有没有破。
lines.en: I turn to check the shell for cracks.

lines.zh: 黑森林里光线暗，我慢下来。
lines.en: The dark forest is dim. I slow down.
I keep to the bank where it's firm.

lines.zh: 我最后停在水边，慢慢喘。
lines.en: I stop at the water's edge and breathe.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇里挤过去，壳刮着叶子。
lines.en: I push through the reeds, the shell rasping the leaves.

lines.zh: 我踩进一处软泥，陷到膝盖。
lines.en: I step into soft mud and sink to the knee.

lines.zh: 壳口只留一条缝，我在看水。
lines.en: Only a slit of shell stays open; I watch the water.

lines.zh: 壳上有水珠，一颗颗滑下去。
lines.en: Droplets run down the shell one by one.
I sit in the mud. Comfortable.

lines.zh: 我身上有股味儿，我不在意。
lines.en: I carry a smell. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我把软软的身子扭了一下。
lines.en: I twist my soft body once.
Water runs past the shell's rim.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，只是泡着。
lines.en: I do nothing but soak.
I hold still like an empty shell.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛从壳口往外看。
lines.en: My eyes look out from the shell's mouth.
I'm waiting for the water to cool.

lines.zh: 我把壳在石头上蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I scrape the shell on a stone.

lines.zh: 泥巴糊住了壳口，我抹掉。
lines.en: Mud's clogged the shell's mouth; I wipe it clear.
A fish swims past my feet.
I let the shell sink a touch lower.
One step from the water, that's all.

lines.zh: 我从壳里看你，只看一半。
lines.en: I watch you from the shell. Only half of you shows.
Don't step on me. The shell would crack.
Want to ride? My back is broad.

lines.zh: 你靴子上的泥，是河底的。
lines.en: The mud on your boots came from the riverbed.
I ease out of the shell a little.

lines.zh: 这滩上我常来，你新来的。
lines.en: I come to this flat often. You're new.

lines.zh: 你手伸过来，我缩了一点。
lines.en: You reach out, so I shrink a little.
I'm soft, but not afraid of people.
Are you taking me along?
I'm slow. Wait for me.
In water I'm more at ease.
You crouched down. That's rare.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，眼睛在壳口后面。
lines.en: I look up, my eyes behind the shell's mouth.

lines.zh: 你的靴子上还挂着水草。
lines.en: There's still weed on your boots.
I slowly shift aside.
A new split has opened in the shell.
I pull in and recover slowly.
My body goes slack and I flop in the water.
That knocked my shell askew.
A crack splits my shell opening; I sink into the mud.
I shift deeper into the water.
I tuck my soft body in tighter.

lines.zh: 泥糊住了伤口，反而好点。
lines.en: Mud's packed over the wound. That helps.
I'm still alive. Don't finish it.
The shell will remember that blow.
That smell agrees with me.
I'm not particular. The smell is enough.
I shuffle over, shell rocking.

lines.zh: 你搁在地上，我慢慢过去。
lines.en: Set it on the ground and I'll come slowly.
One mouthful and that's gone.
I stretch my head out and can't reach.
I eat dung balls too — do not call me picky.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就能碰到。
lines.en: A little closer and I can touch it.
Let me smell it properly first.
All right, I'll shuffle over.

lines.zh: 水里漂来的，我也想尝尝。
lines.en: What floats by, I'd like to try too.
Lower your arm a bit.

lines.zh: 我的贝壳磕在石头上，闷响。
lines.en: My shell knocks against the stone with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，壳在身后晃。
lines.en: I step back and the shell sways.
I'm soft, but the shell is hard.
Don't stand behind my shell.
That nearly tipped me over.
I slowly right myself.

lines.zh: 你踩了一脚泥，溅到我壳上。
lines.en: You stepped in mud and it splashed my shell.

lines.zh: 我往水里挪了挪避开你。
lines.en: I shift into the water to avoid you.
That knock doesn't matter.
Steady. Don't push me.

lines.zh: 我们这种，壳是最大的资本。
lines.en: For my kind, the shell is the main asset.

lines.zh: 你壳上那道裂纹，挺好看。
lines.en: That crack on your shell. Rather fine.
Let's stay in the water a while.
I'm slow. You'll have to wait.
The mud's warmer than the bank.
I'm soft. Safe to lean on.
Don't mind my smell.
Not many of my kind around here.
When the water falls, we go ashore.
Good. Let's just stay like this.
I dip and take it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这东西在水里滑，抓不住。
lines.en: It's slippery in the water.
I tuck it into my shell.
Good for one meal.
I pick it up and bring it to my nose.
I press it under my body.
Too hard to bite open.

lines.zh: 掉在水里的，我沉下去拿。
lines.en: It fell in the water; I dip down for it.
I haul it up onto the bank.
Tucked away. Don't let the water take it.

lines.zh: 芦苇那边有东西踩进泥里。
lines.en: Something steps into the mud beyond the reeds.
I look out from the shell.
That's not a sound I know.
I ease back into the water.
I'm safer in the water.
I peer that way.
I judge how far off it still is.
If it enters the water, I'll go.
I shrink until only the shell shows.
Right. I know where it is.

lines.zh: 壳沿一沉，我把头缩回去。
lines.en: The shell rim dips and I pull my head back.

lines.zh: 就这一片浅滩，退不了多远。
lines.en: Only this shallow flat. Not far to retreat.
I move deeper until the water's at my chest.
I watch it from the shell's mouth.
If it comes close, I'll sink.

lines.zh: 我在泥里不动，很难看见。
lines.en: I keep still in the mud. Hard to spot.
I count its steps. Heavy ones.
It's on the bank. I'm in the water.
Half a metre more and it's deep enough.
The slime on my shell is still wet.
My shell is the color of the mud.
A little longer and it'll go.
It won't dare enter the water.
Right. I'm safe.
I fling a bit of something at it.

lines.zh: 这一下不讲道理，可有效。
lines.en: It isn't dignified, but it works.
One shell bash. A dull thud.
I'm soft. My blows don't hurt.
It backed off. I'll call that a win.
I pull into the shell and wait.

lines.zh: 这一下糊在它护甲上了。
lines.en: That's smeared on its armor now.

lines.zh: 背着壳的我，水里也走得动。
lines.en: Shell on my back, I still move in water.
I'm quicker in the water.
It won't touch me. Afraid of the mess.
I can't win, but I can stall.
That should cost it a few steps.

lines.zh: 我从水里浮上来，壳先出水。
lines.en: I surface, shell first.

lines.zh: 这处浅滩水草多，正合适。
lines.en: Weedy shallows here. Just right.
I land and splash a ring of mud.
A few of my kind are by the river.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬上岸，身上滴水。
lines.en: I crawl up the bank, dripping.
Sun on the shell. Warm.

lines.zh: 我先找了块泥地坐下来。
lines.en: I find a muddy patch and sit.

lines.zh: 这里水浅，跑不掉也淹不着。
lines.en: Shallow here. I can't drown, can't flee far.

lines.zh: 我背上落了片叶子，没管。
lines.en: A leaf landed on my back. I leave it.

lines.zh: 我把头伸出壳外，闻了闻。
lines.en: I put my head out and sniff.
The water smells of weed.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到水深一点的地方。
lines.en: I shuffle to deeper water.
I put my head out of the reeds.

lines.zh: 这里水不急，我可以待着。
lines.en: The water's slack here. I can stay.

lines.zh: 火烤得壳发脆，边角在响。
lines.en: Fire made my shell brittle; the edges creak.

lines.zh: 我从岸上滚下去，壳磕在石上。
lines.en: I roll off the bank and the shell hits stone.

lines.zh: 水我是不怕的，可这水太浑了。
lines.en: Water doesn't frighten me, but this water's too thick.

lines.zh: 冲击把我连同泥一起掀起来。
lines.en: The blast throws me up with the mud.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进壳里，卡住了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in the shell and stays.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的软身子发僵。
lines.en: That force stiffens my soft body.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连壳都拖不动。
lines.en: Too long hungry and I can't drag the shell.

lines.zh: 雷落进浅滩，我的软身子一缩。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the shallows and my soft body flinches.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我干得难受。
lines.en: No water in the void. I dry out.
